name: Portal chat voice, More label, reorderable rail, reset, and left-aligned CTA acceptance
command: node --input-type=module < live-shadow-preference Playwright probe against http://127.0.0.1:3801
summary: The complete Portal Playwright suite passed 25/25. A subsequent headless Chromium probe against the promoted build on :3801 exercised the requested voice placement, More label, pointer and keyboard order persistence, reset behavior, fixed rail regions, and CTA geometry without mutating server preferences.

assertions.evidence: npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts ran 25 tests with one worker; 25 passed in 43.8s, including portal-more-sections pointer/keyboard reorder, reset, reload persistence, pin/unpin, More, and fixed-control cases.
Live :3801 DOM returned voiceCount=1, voiceHeader=1, voiceTopbar=0, voiceSettings=true.
Live :3801 DOM returned searchMic=1 for the independent Ask Papercup by voice affordance.
Live :3801 DOM returned workspaceSortable=0, moreInsideScroller=0, settingsSortable=0, and settingsInFoot=1.
Live :3801 pointer drag moved Mail to the first sortable slot, emitted the placement status, and returned pointerReload=true after reload.
Live :3801 keyboard drag waited for aria-pressed sensor activation, moved Chat history up one slot, emitted the placement status, and returned keyboardReload=true after reload.
Live :3801 returned resetVisible=true and resetFull=true; the persisted reset order included home plus unpinned prs and coord tokens.
Live :3801 computed .desktop-cta-bar justify-content as flex-start and measured an 18px inline-start gap.
With PRs active, the live More trigger returned visible text More and aria-current=page.
The live probe captured zero console errors and serverPreferencesUnchanged=true after intercepting all preference PUTs in a shadow object.
